title: LumenHealth partnership scout notes
content:
Notes to self: LumenHealth — midsize ambulatory care chain (regional, East Coast). Looks like they run a mix of Epic outpatient and some custom scheduling. Potential interest areas: patient messaging triage, physician notes summarization, insurance pre-auth automation for referrals. They called out cost predictability and audit trails as blockers in job posting for "Head of Digital Ops" (shared street cred with compliance).

Quick context:
- Founded 2012, ~3,200 employees, 42 clinics across 6 states.
- CTO (informal) = Daniel Rivera (LinkedIn skim) — previously at MedBridge. CIO = Carol Nguyen (possible champion for infra).
- Tech indicators: Azure primary, some GCP for analytics. They use Okta for SSO. HIPAA + SOC2 required.

Why Redwood might fit (hypothesis):
- They need low-latency inference for live-chat triage and EHR-assist features; cost predictability is critical for annual budget planning. Redwood Dedicated offering + Private (VPC) could appeal.
- Audit logs + KMS integrations align with compliance asks.
- If we can show token-level cost savings (batching + caching) on a real workload (clinical note summarization), they may consider a pilot.

Objections I expect + suggested counters:
- "We can build it ourselves / use vendor X": emphasize ops cost and long tail of maintenance; propose a quick 4-week pilot with a defined SLO and rollback plan. Offer comparison: 6-month internal build vs 4-week Redwood pilot + documented ROI.
- "HIPAA risk / data residency": share private deployment option (VPC + KMS/HSM) and offer to set up a short architecture review with infra/security within 48 hrs. Mention our audit logs and optional on-prem package.
- "Price unpredictability": show dedicated/reserved capacity pricing model + example TCO math (see quick calc below). Offer 30-day rate lock for pilot.

Quick TCO sketch (to refine):
- Current manual summarization: ~2 FTEs handling triage at $120k each fully loaded = $300k/year.
- Estimated Redwood pilot: Dedicated small pool + private control plane = $45k/mo committed (example) => $540k/year but saves FTEs and reduces turnaround times; need refined with real token estimates.
- Angle: show unit cost per summarized encounter and latency improvements.

Outbound/email draft (short):
Subject: Quick pilot idea to cut clinical note turnaround at LumenHealth
Hi Carol — I’m Aisha at Redwood Inference. We help health systems run LLM-powered features with predictable latency, costs, and PI/audit controls (hosted, dedicated, or private). I noticed LumenHealth has been prioritizing automation for outpatient notes — would you be open to a 30-minute call to explore a 4-week pilot focused on clinical note summarization (we handle infra, security review, and a simple ROI calc)?
If yes, propose Tue/Thu AM next week. If no, would you point me to the right owner?

Call script (1st intro, 20 min):
- 0–3 min: quick intros + reason for reach (pilot idea + security-first posture)
- 3–8 min: discovery: current process for notes, volumes (avg encs/day), pain points, who signs off on vendor security reviews
- 8–14 min: show 2 slides (conceptual) — architecture options (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private), emphasis on audit logs and KMS
- 14–18 min: pilot mechanics: 4-week, 1 clinic, defined dataset, success metric (avg summarization time, clinician satisfaction, token cost per note), opt-out + rollback
- 18–20 min: next steps: security contact, pilot scope doc, estimate delivery timeline (infra + onboarding ~2w)

Data points to get in discovery:
- Clinic throughput (avg encs/day, peak)
- Median note length (tokens), structured vs free text ratio
- Existing EHR integrations and person who owns them
- Compliance reviewers + timeline for security review
- Preferred region (data residency)

Meeting prep TODOs (Aisha):
- Pull anonymized sample conversation/note sizes from our last health pilot (ask Max) — due 2026-02-25
- Draft pilot scope (1 pager) + risk checklist — due 2026-02-27
- Pricing sketch for Dedicated small + 3 months burst — ask Finance for custom estimate (ticket RED-3320)
- Slack intro template for Carol's security team — one-liner + 2 attch links (arch diagram, SOC2 cert)

Possible pilot success metrics (examples):
- 90% of generated summaries rated >=4/5 by clinicians in week 4
- Median turnaround <30 minutes (was 6 hours)
- Per-encounter cost reduction >=40% vs manual

Risks / open questions:
- Will legal push for on-prem? Need cost delta if so.
- Who will manage deployment if Private is chosen (customer or Redwood ops)? Clarify in pilot scope.
- Token size estimates unknown — must get sample notes ASAP.

Thoughts for objection handling bank (quick lines):
- If they ask about hallucinations: "We pair model choices + evals with a small human-in-the-loop verification and tuned prompt templates — pilot includes an eval set and regression alerts."
- If they ask about SLA: "Pilot: we commit to latency targets for the trial cluster and instrument tracing so we can iterate on batching/seq-length configs."

Next actions (short):
- Cold email to Carol + CC CTO Daniel (send by 2026-02-23)
- Get sample notes (ask via secure SFTP or hashed sample) — Max to own
- Draft pilot scope & risk checklist — Aisha to draft, Sofia to review
- Book 30-min intro slot for discovery (target week of 2026-02-29)

Random notes / heuristics:
- Use language "predictable unit cost" not "cheaper" in first outreach.
- Avoid heavy product jargon on the first call; focus on outcomes (time-to-note, clinician load).
- If they request benchmark vs vendor X, offer to run a short A/B on our infra and provide token-level cost comparison (data-limited).

End of doc — informal scratchpad, will clean and move to shared drive once pilot is greenlit.
